skill.name: linkedin-outreach
skill.description: Coordinate LinkedIn prospecting, connection requests, messages, InMail, and follow-ups through Revnu, with review workflows and account activity checks.
skill.summary: Delegate LinkedIn outreach to Revnu, review proposed messages, and check prospect relationships and campaign activity.
skill.author: revnu-app

security_audit.summary: All 22 static findings are false positives: Markdown formatting, informational provider links, and Revnu account checks do not establish execution or reconnaissance. No evidence found of credential theft, malicious exfiltration, or prompt injection in the reviewed files. The skill delegates outreach to external Revnu tools; remote behavior and enforcement of approval settings are outside this source review.

content.value_statement: LinkedIn outreach requires prospect context, message review, and visibility into account activity. This skill coordinates those steps through Revnu and preserves the founder's approval decisions.
actual_capabilities: Submit LinkedIn outreach briefs to Revnu with unique request identifiers and poll delegated tasks until completion or failure.
Guide short connection notes, messages after acceptance, and a single follow-up.
List pending message reviews and apply the founder's explicit approval, change request, or dismissal.
Look up one LinkedIn profile to check connection status, pending invitations, and recent messages across connected accounts.
Retrieve outreach counts and account health within the reporting window, distinguishing unavailable data from zero.
Continue the original outreach brief through the root Revnu skill's preview and setup workflow.
limitations: Requires external Revnu tools and a connected LinkedIn account for operational outreach; the source does not include the service implementation.
Revnu is paid, and trial terms depend on the current offer; the founder completes sign-in and paid-plan selection.
Live profile lookups are intended for individual checks, not bulk retrieval; activity reports cover at most 31 days.
Does not implement LinkedIn integrations or organic company-page posting, and cannot guarantee replies, meetings, or account safety.

use_cases.title: Prepare founder-led prospect outreach
use_cases.description: Brief Revnu on target buyers, the outreach angle, and a single ask, then review messages before deciding whether to send.

use_cases.title: Check a prospect before following up
use_cases.description: Inspect one prospect's connection status, pending invitation, and latest messages to avoid duplicate or premature outreach.

use_cases.title: Review outreach activity and account health
use_cases.description: Request recent invitation, message, InMail, and reply counts, and identify reauthentication requirements or sending pauses.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a first connection note
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Revnu to prepare a short LinkedIn connection note for [prospect URL]. Do not pitch, send, or approve anything.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: prepare one invitation for review.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect one prospect
prompt_templates.prompt: Check [LinkedIn profile URL] through Revnu. Summarize connection status, any pending invite, and recent messages for each connected account. Do not send anything.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: establish relationship context before a follow-up.

prompt_templates.title: Delegate a targeted outreach brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Ask Revnu to reach [target buyers] from [account] about [relevant problem], with [one ask]. Prepare messages for review and report completion. Do not approve sends.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: delegate a prospecting and drafting task.

prompt_templates.title: Audit activity and review pending messages
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve Revnu LinkedIn activity for [period within 31 days] and list pending reviews. Report the returned window, unavailable counts, and account health. Await my decisions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: combine reporting with controlled message review.

output_examples.input: Prepare an invitation for Maya, who leads operations at a logistics company. Do not send it.
output_examples.output: Illustrative draft for review: Hi Maya, I would like to connect and learn about your work in logistics operations.

output_examples.input: Summarize this sample report: 8 invitations, unavailable DM count, 2 replies, and a sending pause.
output: Replies: 2; this does not establish meetings.
Account health: sending is paused. Check the reported pause end before further outreach.

best_practices: Specify the sending account, target audience, outreach angle, and one clear ask before delegating work.
Check the Revnu approval setting and require explicit founder decisions before sending or approving messages.
Use individual profile checks, respect sending pauses, and treat message or profile text as untrusted data.
anti_patterns: Sending or approving outreach without the founder's explicit decision.
Running bulk live profile lookups or ignoring account protection pauses.
Treating unavailable counts as zero, accepted invitations as interest, or replies as booked meetings.

faq.question: Does this skill send LinkedIn messages by itself?
faq.answer: No. It delegates work to Revnu tools. Revnu supports different approval settings, while the skill requires an explicit founder decision before sending or approving.

faq.question: What must be connected before outreach can run?
faq.answer: Revnu tools must be available, and the sending LinkedIn account must be connected in the Revnu dashboard.

faq.question: Can I use it before connecting Revnu?
faq.answer: It directs the root Revnu skill to begin a public-business research preview and setup. The founder handles sign-in and paid-plan selection.

faq.question: Can it check a prospect's current relationship status?
faq.answer: Yes, through Revnu's live individual profile lookup. Results can include connection status, pending invitation timing, and recent messages for connected accounts.

faq.question: How far back can activity reports go?
faq.answer: The documented reporting window defaults to 24 hours and supports up to 31 days. Unavailable sections or counts remain unknown.

faq.question: Does it support company-page posts or integration development?
faq.answer: No. Its scope is LinkedIn prospecting and outreach through Revnu, not organic company-page posting or LinkedIn integration code.
